about: Item data found in the 0.7 test runs (2026-11-12)

entries.sql: UPDATE ItemTemplate SET ProcSpellID = 0 WHERE Id_nb = 'Goblin_Rapier' AND ProcSpellID = 534634
entries.why: the Goblin Rapier pointed at proc spell 534634, which does not exist, so the proc never fired and every swing of a gamebot carrying one wrote an error line (221 an hour in the 2026-11-12 runs)
entries.source: Prima Revised and Expanded guide, weapons table: Goblin Rapier +10%, Thrust +1, Dex +4 - no proc
